name: Glasses Finder
short_description: Find glasses by face shape, prescription, fit, style, and budget.
long_description: Glasses Finder ranks physical eyeglass frames by shopper fit across face shape, frame width, prescription type, progressive-lens support, material, style, lens preferences, and budget. Results explain tradeoffs and include affiliate disclosure before outbound shopping links.
example_prompts: Find progressive glasses under $200 that suit a round face.
Find lightweight frames for a narrow square face.
Compare medium-width glasses with blue-light lenses.
affiliate_disclosure: Glasses Finder may earn a commission when users buy through partner links. Recommendations rank user fit first.
review_notes: The published deployment exposes only recommend_glasses. Staging uses a curated catalog; affiliate tracking is enabled only after merchant approval.
